question: Does the native retained-whole fixture supply both a grounded chart-independent inventory and an admission of the actual conflicting NE/NN reader pair?

criteria.inventory: Generate the fixture from its source histories, validate all retained native packets/contacts, and compute inventory from the retained occupied-body record independently of the active chart. Do not load a Pb target or choose counts.
criteria.pairBinding: Bind the actual source root, PN prefix and both NE/NN targets to ONE retained whole with source markings/occurrences intact. Test identity binding and every existing P-packet marked-root frame in the fixture; do not relocate the two equal source cells independently.
criteria.disposition: Record inventory and pair-binding outcomes separately. Generic whole-field sewing or inventory preservation does not discharge pair admission.
criteria.failureScope: Failure under the existing occupied-species/frame binding is not a proof against every future whole-reader model. Any broader carrier reinterpretation must be registered separately.

controls: active-chart species is not the whole inventory
all interfaces, not only generating edges
same source cell must map to same target cell
shared primitive cannot be assigned two fixed species
no independent frame choice per alternative
deliverable: Fresh native fixture validation and whole-field check, chart-independent inventory table, explicit pair-binding checks and bounded disposition.
